outlet_headlines.headline: Meta open-sources Muse Glimmer, a 30B-parameter agentic model that runs on a single consumer GPU
outlet_headlines.gist: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Glimmer under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face -- a 30B dense multimodal model tuned for local agentic tool use and coding, compressed under 20GB via 4-bit quantization.

outlet_headlines.headline: OpenAI expands Daybreak cybersecurity program, launches GPT-5.6-Cyber
outlet_headlines.gist: OpenAI split Daybreak into Blue (relaxed-guardrail GPT-5.6 Sol for defenders) and Red tiers, with new model GPT-5.6-Cyber completing 95% of advanced security queries vs 1.5% for the standard model.

outlet_headlines.headline: Nvidia partners with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR on $500B AI financing push
outlet_headlines.gist: Nvidia struck deals with six Wall Street firms to create financing platforms meant to mobilize over $500 billion in third-party capital for chips, power generation and data centers; Jensen Huang said none of the six he approached turned him down.

outlet_headlines.headline: Intel launches $15 billion stock sale to fund AI expansion
outlet_headlines.gist: Intel's first public share sale since its 1971 listing aims to fund physical AI, purpose-built silicon and advanced packaging; stock fell over 3% premarket on dilution concerns.

outlet_headlines.headline: Anthropic says an unreleased Claude research model pushed a 160-year-old math bound from 41.6% to 67.2%
outlet_headlines.gist: An unreleased Claude version raised the proven lower bound for Riemann zeta function zeros satisfying the Riemann Hypothesis, using 31M output tokens, ~60 subagents and producing a Lean formalization reviewed by outside mathematicians.

outlet_headlines.headline: Google confirms August 12 'Made by Google' event; Pixel 11 line and Pixel Watch 5 expected
outlet_headlines.gist: Google's NYC hardware keynote is set for tomorrow (Aug 12), expected to unveil Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pro XL, Pro Fold, and new Pixel Watch 5 wearables.

outlet_headlines.headline: AMD to acquire Taalas, a startup that etches AI model weights directly into silicon
outlet_headlines.gist: AMD is buying Toronto-based Taalas, which bakes model weights into custom chips instead of storing them in HBM for a potential order-of-magnitude inference speedup, to fold into its Instinct/EPYC/Helios roadmap.

outlet_headlines.headline: AI notetaker tl;dv left 181,874 meetings across 84,312 users queryable by any authenticated user
outlet_headlines.gist: Researcher bobdahacker disclosed a missing Firestore rule exposed government, university and corporate meetings -- including live, joinable calls -- after tl;dv allegedly sat on the report since January with no fix.

outlet_headlines.headline: Microsoft's 10-K shows it booked $24.1 billion in fiscal 2026 revenue from OpenAI
outlet_headlines.gist: New SEC filing detail shows roughly 70% of Microsoft's AI revenue is concentrated in OpenAI, which also committed to an additional $250B in Azure purchases under the revised partnership.

outlet_headlines.headline: SK Hynix to invest $38.1 billion in two new memory chip plants as AI demand booms
outlet_headlines.gist: SK Hynix will build DRAM/NAND fabs in Yongin and Cheongju, though new capacity won't arrive until 2029, meaning current AI-driven memory shortages and price spikes likely persist for years.

outlet_headlines.headline: Huawei's Ascend 950 chips seen closing gap with Nvidia as China AI chip market share flips
outlet_headlines.gist: Analysts forecast Nvidia's China AI chip share collapsing from 40% to 8% in 2026 as Huawei's Ascend 950 scales and Beijing pushes homegrown hardware amid stalled H200 shipments.

outlet_headlines.headline: Metabase discloses CVSS-10 zero-day SQL injection exploited in the wild, granting admin access
outlet_headlines.gist: An unauthenticated SQL injection in Metabase's password-reset endpoint let attackers gain admin access and steal connected-database credentials; Framework and Tally have already reported customer-data theft.

outlet_headlines.headline: Iran-linked hackers' cyberattack on US water utilities spreads to seven-plus states
outlet_headlines.gist: Suspected Iranian actors are exploiting default passwords on internet-facing PLCs at water facilities, forcing some utilities into manual operation and boil-water notices; CISA, FBI, NSA and DOE issued a joint advisory.

outlet_headlines.headline: Apple confirmed prepping September 9 event for iPhone 18 Pro and its first foldable iPhone
outlet_headlines.gist: Apple is expected to send invites around August 26 for a September 9 keynote unveiling iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and a foldable iPhone, with Bloomberg's Gurman forecasting $100-200 price hikes from chip and memory cost pressure.

outlet_headlines.headline: Musk says xAI's Grok 4.6 is coming within days, with a 2.1-trillion-parameter Grok 4.7 to follow
outlet_headlines.gist: xAI has reportedly compressed its release cycle to every two-to-three weeks as it races to match Anthropic's Claude update cadence, with Grok 5 teased as the 'next major leap.'

outlet_headlines.headline: India's Semicon 2.0 chip plan is 'just beginning' as four plants now package and test commercial chips
outlet_headlines.gist: MeitY's Semicon 2.0 push (Rs 1.275 trillion / ~$13.2B) has Micron's Sanand plant, Kaynes Semicon and CG Power's JV already in commercial operation, with a fourth unit due before year-end as India chases mature-node OSAT share.

outlet_headlines.headline: Lok Sabha passes bill enabling government to levy charges on large-value UPI transactions
outlet_headlines.gist: The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 gives the Centre legal power to charge banks/PSPs for UPI and other digital-payment rails; the Finance Ministry says any charges would target large-value transactions, not everyday users.

outlet_headlines.headline: Flipkart to launch a Bengaluru food-delivery app undercutting Zomato and Swiggy on commissions
outlet_headlines.gist: Flipkart plans a ~August 15 Bengaluru launch charging restaurants roughly 10% commission versus the 16-30% charged by Zomato and Swiggy, entering a space Rapido's Ownly also recently joined.
